activity_summary: Edmund brought ale and sat on the floor, not in the orchard, and asked how a king is put down on a stage. You told him the Master has cut the scene that showed it, and that it will not be played or written back. He read you the name as a cue. You wrote three lines one-handed, a fair copy of what Saturday already had, and you sent him to finish school. Nothing is arranged for him in London.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered the question without restoring the scene, and wrote three lines.
